title: How AI tools such as SuperBrain and Naver's Talking Buddy are helping South Korea's elderly ease loneliness, detect emergencies, and slow cognitive decline (Choe Sang-Hun/New York Times)
summary: Choe Sang-Hun / New York Times: How AI tools such as SuperBrain and Naver's Talking Buddy are helping South Korea's elderly ease loneliness, detect emergencies, and slow cognitive decline — In the world's fastest aging society, artificial intelligence is being used to make care calls to older adults who live alone and to fight dementia.
